variants.name: Chicken 415 g
variants.about_this_item:
SIMBA CAT CHUNKIES WITH CHICKEN is a complete pet food for adult cat. Chunks in gravy formulated with quality ingredients such as chicken, source of protein and minerals, are oven-baked to enhance their natural taste and stimulate your pet's daily appetite. The formulation has been developed with a specific combination of vitamins A-D3-E to meet the nutritional requirements of your pet's daily needs. No added colours or preservatives.

  • Complete pet food for adult cats
  • Chunks in gravy, oven cooked
  • No added colours or preservatives
  • No cruelty test
  • Made in Italy
  • Pack size: 415 g
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: meat and animal derivatives (chicken 12%), cereals, eggs and egg derivatives, minerals.

Analytical constituents: crude protein 8.0%, crude fibre 0.8%, crude fat 6.0%, crude ash 2.5%, moisture 80%.

Additives (nutritional additives/kg): Vitamin A (Retinyl Acetate) 2000 IU, Vitamin D3 160 IU, Vitamin E (all rac-alpha-tocopheryl-acetate 3a700i) 5 mg.
variants.feeding_instructions:
Instructions for use: To be served at room temperature. Fresh and clean water should be available at all times. Storage conditions: once opened, keep refrigerated and consume within 2 days. Feeding instructions: for a medium size cat (4 kg), 200 grams of product daily, shared in 2 meals. Do not open the can, if it is dented or swollen. Animal food, not suitable for human consumption.

Recommended daily feeding intakes (grams/day):

Weight of adult cat (kg)456
